app_fee.value: The application fee is USD 90 for international applicants (USD 65 for U.S. applicants) for all programs other than the MBA and MPA.
app_fee.quote: All other programs: U.S. Graduate: $65 International Graduate: $90

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers are only for U.S. citizens and permanent residents; they are not available to international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers are not available for international citizens.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School leaves the GRE to each program; check the program record.
gre_general.quote: Most programs require the GRE or GMAT. Check with your program of application to see which test is required or if a waiver is available.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 79 (or 4 on the 6-point scale) is the Graduate School minimum; departments may set higher scores.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: 79 (120 scale) or 4 (6-point scale) internet-based test

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall band 6.5 minimum (DET 115 also accepted at university level).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: An overall band of 6.5 on the Academic Examination

english_waiver.value: India is on UT Austin's list of qualifying countries, so applicants from India (or with a bachelor's from an Indian institution) are exempt from the English test.
english_waiver.quote: International applicants who are from a qualifying country are exempt from this requirement. Additionally, applicants are exempt from the requirement if they possess a bachelor’s degree from an institution in the U.S. or a qualifying country. | Guyana India Ireland

notes: Each graduate program sets its own application deadline. Departments may set higher English minimums.
